parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN).

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Minimum value: **0**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent query exists.
- If a subsequent query exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC-connected instance.
